subject: Thanks for the time today
opener: Thanks for the time today. Here is what I took away.

bullets.text: You called to read out a suspicious email about CallForge. It is a phishing template using our name, so please do not click the link.
Nothing moved on the deal itself. The agreement is still with Dr. Mehta.

close: We did not land on a specific next step. What would be useful to you right now?
